jobs.label: IC2_calllog
jobs.prompt: Copy exactly the icon style of the 2009 feature phone main menu in the reference images: cheap low-detail 3D render, hard glossy plastic highlights, slightly crude shapes, strong saturated primary colours, thin dark outline, small drop shadow, no square tile. Draw ONE icon in that style: a phone handset next to a small list sheet with coloured arrows (call history). Big, centred, on a perfectly flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF). No text, no letters, no logos.
